title: AnnexRecord
description:
One `signoff-v0` annex line (CER-1633, `spec/records/signoff-v0.md`).

Field names match the daemon wire exactly where the dialect agrees with
§8 (`payload_hash`, `classification.{tier,policy,basis}`,
`signoff.{decision,by,note}`, tier spellings, `decision` values). They
deviate only where the pre-daemon client cannot do better — `verb` carries
a dotted subverb, `signoff.marker` is annex-only, the top-level `at` maps
to `signoff.at`, and there is no `action.id`/`signoff.action` binding
(the two §8 records are fused into one line).

Unknown fields are tolerated by `serde_json` (they land in the ignored map
and are dropped on parse), so a hook that adds a dialect field reflex does
not yet name still parses — the spec-from-practice invariant that fields
here only ever get *renamed or promoted*, never silently re-meant.

at.description:
Submission time (maps to `signoff.at` on promotion — §8 records carry
no submission timestamp of their own).

reflex.description: `"0.0-annex"` — marks dialect records apart from daemon `"0.1"`.

AnnexAction.description: The `action` block of an annex record.

agent.description:
Best-effort harness/session attribution; absence is `"unknown"`,
never fabricated.

params.description:
Non-secret coordinates only (repo, target, verb qualifiers). The
annex must be safe to read aloud.

payload_hash.description:
`"sha256:…"` — the gated command line IS the payload; hashed, never
logged raw.

verb.description:
A dotted subverb (`commit-code.merge`); on promotion the base before
the first dot becomes the daemon `Verb`, the subverb moves to `params`.

AnnexClassification.description:
The `classification` block — self-reported by the hook (its blocking
behavior), not produced by the daemon.

tier.description: Tier spellings match the daemon wire (uppercase RED/GREEN/YELLOW).

AnnexSignoff.description: The `signoff` block — inferred from the operator's override marker.

by.description: The `# allow-*` marker IS the ratification act.

decision.description:
`approved` (marker present) | `rejected` (blocked, no marker). The
daemon's `expired` cannot occur here — hooks decide instantly.

marker.description:
Annex-only field (folds into `signoff.by` provenance on promotion).
Omitted, never `null`, when absent: the schema says `string`.

SignoffDecision.description: The founder's decision on a sign-off card (soma §8).
